## AI Instructions

Repo: https://github.com/AllensCreations/MCPE-Curseforges.git (branch main)
Export: two plain .txt files. `<name>.txt` = the pack (index, these instructions, every file). `<name>_tools.txt` = SKILL.md, PACK_GENERATOR_INSTRUCTIONS.md, INSTRUCTIONS.md and the helper scripts. Read both before changing anything. The zip root also holds SKILL.md: read it FIRST for a new pack.

## Pack work (create or update)
- UPDATE: the pack files are in `<name>.txt`. Change only what was requested.
- Vanilla limit blocks a mechanic: use a modular workaround per INSTRUCTIONS.md 1.12, never drop the feature silently.
- NEW pack: read SKILL.md first, then follow PACK_GENERATOR_INSTRUCTIONS.md Part 4 and deliver ONE pack `.sh` from `scripts/make_pack_script.py` (the project travels inside it as base64). NEVER deliver separate zip, pack, json, js or b64 files.
- INSTRUCTIONS.md wins over PACK_GENERATOR_INSTRUCTIONS.md on any conflict. These instructions win over both on the reply format and the Termux script.
- Update: keep pack and module UUIDs unchanged.
- Vanilla reference: `reference/bedrock-samples/bedrock-samples.min.json.gz` (repo, gzip file of about 8 MB, NOT in this export; unzip it first) holds every vanilla Mojang behavior/resource pack JSON as one object once unzipped (`.behavior_pack.entities.zombie`, `.behavior_pack.recipes`, `.resource_pack.entity` ...). Never guess a vanilla component, event, loot or recipe shape: list the exact section under File Needed, then copy the shape from it.
- UI work (menus, forms, HUD, screens): follow INSTRUCTIONS.md 1.13 and apply the ALN UI Redesign skin from `assets/aln-ui-redesign/` (README.txt, design.json, font/README.txt in the tools txt). Textures are not exported; if the pack's resource_pack is missing, ask for it. Never claim anything was tested in Minecraft unless it was.
- Update: deliver the repo change as the Termux script below. New pack: the pack `.sh` above. Never a separate payload or base64 file.

## Destination
Repo-root-relative folders for this work:
- MCPEDL/Addons/Vanilla-Quality-of-Life
- .sh paths start at repo root, stay inside these folders. New files go here too.
- First folder -> `DEST=` variable at script top. Use it for every path and `git add`.

## Rules
1. NEVER invent features, versions, links, assets, test results.
2. Output only what changed. Smallest edits. No unrelated rewrites.
3. No notes/summaries/explanations unless asked.
4. Any project type (add-on, map, script, workflow, website). Keep folder layout. New project = own new folder beside similar ones.

## Update request = ONE Termux script
- Name: `<Repofilename>_<Version>_<RAND>.sh` (e.g. `Monster-Companions_v2_k7q2x.sh`). Deliver as downloadable file.
- Repofilename: project/folder/file changed. No extension, no spaces (hyphens ok).
- Version: new vX format. Update = X+1 (e.g., v1 -> v2, or legacy 1.3.4 -> v2).
- RAND: >=5 random lowercase letters/digits. Fresh every script. NEVER reuse (earlier reply or existing file), so a new script never overwrites or re-runs an old one.
- Same exact name in reply steps.
Script order:
1. `#!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash` + `set -e`
2. `cd "$HOME/MCPE-Curseforges"`; `git clone` repo URL first if folder missing
3. `git pull --rebase`
4. Apply ALL changes as exact search-and-replace edits: write a spec and run `python3 scripts/make_update_script.py spec.txt` (format in `scripts/apply_update.py`; `--verify <clone>` dry-runs it). The tool applies edits atomically, sets the manifest version and writes both changelogs. Size decides the method. SMALL update (a few edits, under about 60% of any file touched): search and replace only. LARGE update (most of a file, many new files, a redesign): use the best method, `@@ create`/`@@ overwrite` in the same spec, never many fragile edits. Either way ONE `.sh`. No separate downloads.
5. Validate every changed .json with python3. Stop on error.
5b. Verify top CHANGELOG.md heading == new vX == script filename version. Stop on mismatch. If project has manifests: run `python3 scripts/manifest_tools.py --project "$DEST" --set X.0.0` (or `vX`), then `python3 scripts/manifest_tools.py --project "$DEST" --check` and `python3 scripts/validate_manifest_titles.py --project "$DEST"`. Stop on error. Every update must change the manifests so the build changes. Never hand-edit manifest JSON for versions.
5c. If INSTRUCTIONS.md or PACK_GENERATOR_INSTRUCTIONS.md changed: run `python3 scripts/check_instruction_files.py`. Stop on error
6. `git add` changed paths only; `git commit -m "<short message>"`; `git push`
6b. Add an entry to the ROOT `CHANGELOG.md` (repo-wide, newest first under `---`): `## [vN] - YYYY-MM-DD - [Update Name]` (N = `REPO_VERSION` + 1, a single whole number such as v80, set by the update tool, never by hand), groups `### Added` / `### Improved & Balanced` / `### Fixed`, bullets `- **Title**: what changed`. Every script, tooling-only included.
7. After push, do NOT start any workflow. Build Changed Packs & Sync Catalogs runs by itself on every push and rebuilds everything. Nothing auto-bumps; Publish to CurseForge uploads the newest changelog version as written.
8. Idempotent: skip anything already applied.
9. Last line, reached only after a successful push: `rm -f -- "$SELF"` (the script deletes itself; save `SELF="$(readlink -f -- "$0")"` on line 2, before the `cd`).

## Docs (every update, same script)
- Templates STRICT: README.md, DESCRIPTION.md, CHANGELOG.md match templates below exactly: same headings, text, order, labels, bullet format. NEVER add/remove/rename/merge/reorder sections. No boilerplate/extra text. No placeholders: fill every [bracket] with verified content. Accuracy + requested scope outrank template.
- CHANGELOG.md: MANDATORY every update, no exceptions. Add new release entry for the change.
- README.md + DESCRIPTION.md: after change, analyze both in destination folder. Edit ONLY if change makes them inaccurate/incomplete. NEVER remove verified content.

### Versions (vX ONLY)
- Format: single-number version `vX` (e.g. `v2`, `v3`). Old 3-part versions X.Y.Z convert by incrementing major (X+1).
- Update: X+1 (v1 -> v2, v2 -> v3).
- New vX goes in CHANGELOG heading + script filename.
- Manifest versions: Bedrock requires a 3-integer array, so `vX` is mapped internally to `[X, 0, 0]` by `manifest_tools.py --set vX` (never hand-edit JSON). NEVER hand-edit README download links. Build Changed Packs & Sync Catalogs aligns a pack to its highest existing version and rebuilds.
- NEVER put release version in README/DESCRIPTION titles. NEVER reuse a heading.

```
# Changelog — Vanilla Quality of Life

## [v3] - 2026-11-14

### Improved & Balanced
- **Clearer Description**: The listing now follows the new layout with an overview, feature cards, step-by-step instructions, common questions, and a compatibility summary.

### Fixed
- **Leash Details**: The description no longer says the Warden and Wither can be leashed, and no longer claims a fixed number of leashable mobs.
- **Creator Links**: The MCPEDL profile link and its image now appear once and point to the correct page.

<details>
<summary><b>2.1.x</b> (2 releases)</summary>

### [2.1.1] - 2026-11-14

#### Added
- **Swap-Back After Mining**: A moment after you stop mining or fighting, the item that was in Slot 1 returns to its original slot instead of staying swapped.
- **Tree Size Message**: An action-bar message now tells you when a tree was too large to fell completely.

#### Improved & Balanced
- **Faster Auto-Switch**: Auto-switch now waits only about a tenth of a second after a block breaks, so it keeps up with instant-break blocks.
- **Hotbar-Only Tool Search**: Auto-switch now only uses tools from your hotbar, so items in your backpack are never moved.
- **Chain Mining Experience**: Chain mining now spawns at most 10 experience orbs per chain and gives any extra experience straight to you, so far fewer orbs appear.
- **Lighter Held Light Checks**: The held-light update does less work while you carry no light item.

### [2.1.0] - 2026-11-07

#### Added
- **More Held Lights**: Glowstone, Sea Lanterns, Shroomlights, and Jack o'Lanterns now light up your surroundings at Light Level 15 while you hold them.
- **Silk Touch Auto-Switch**: Hitting glass or ice now switches to a Silk Touch tool if you carry one, and bookshelves prefer a Silk Touch Axe.

#### Improved & Balanced
- **Mending Preference**: When two tools are equally good for a job, auto-switch now uses the Mending tool that needs repair first.
- **Grouped Chain Drops**: Tree Capitator and Domino Ore Miner now merge their drops into full stacks within 5-block areas, so far fewer item entities appear.
- **Direct Block Breaking**: Tree Capitator and Domino Ore Miner now break blocks and place their drops directly instead of running game commands.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>2.0.x</b> (1 release)</summary>

### [2.0.0] - 2026-11-06

#### Removed
- **Offhand Swap Command**: The command that swapped your offhand item is removed. Use double-sneak or Sneak + Use in the air instead.
- **Personal Toggles**: The per-player toggles added in the previous update are removed. Choose how Tree Capitator and Domino Ore Miner behave for your world with the Behavior Pack's subpack settings.

#### Added
- **Personal Toggles**: Each player can turn Auto-Switch, Tree Capitator, Domino Ore Miner, and Offhand Quick-Swap on or off for themselves with /scriptevent qol:toggle. Use status to see your settings and reset to turn everything back on.

#### Improved & Balanced
- **Zero Durability Tools**: A tool at 0 durability now breaks only the single block you hit and no longer starts Tree Capitator or Domino Ore Miner.
- **Durability Floor**: Tree Capitator and Domino Ore Miner now use your tool down to 0 durability without breaking it, and the next use of that tool breaks it.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>1.29.x</b> (1 release)</summary>

### [1.29.0] - 2026-11-02

#### Fixed
- **Tool Durability**: Tree Capitator and Domino Ore Miner now reliably wear down the tool you used, even if auto-switch changes your held item right afterward.
- **Mangrove Trees**: Mangrove trees with moss carpet around their roots are now felled, and breaking Muddy Mangrove Roots no longer switches you to a shovel.
- **Auto-Switch After Chain Mining**: Auto-switch now waits about two seconds after a tree or ore vein is chain mined before it can change your tool.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>1.28.x</b> (1 release)</summary>

### [1.28.0] - 2026-11-01

#### Improved & Balanced
- **Clearer Mining Presets**: The three mining presets in the pack settings now describe what they do: Sneak to Chain Mine (Default), Auto Chain Mine: Tool in Slot 1, and Chain Mining Off (Other Features On).
- **Resource Pack Included**: The Behavior Pack now requires its Resource Pack, so both are enabled together when you activate it.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>1.27.x</b> (1 release)</summary>

### [1.27.0] - 2026-11-01

#### Fixed
- **Enchanted Tool Offhand Swap**: Swapping an enchanted or damaged tool into your offhand with a torch no longer resets it, so enchantments and remaining durability are kept.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>1.26.x</b> (1 release)</summary>

### [1.26.0] - 2026-10-29

#### Improved & Balanced
- **Maintenance release**: Repackaged the pack; no gameplay changes were recorded.

#### Improved & Balanced
- **Durability Guard**: Chain mining now stops only when the tool has 0 durability left, instead of at 1.
- **Offhand Torch Placement Removed**: Torches in the offhand can no longer be placed with Sneak + Click. Offhand quick-swap and held-item light still work.

#### Fixed
- **Auto-Switch With Chain Mining**: Auto-switch now pauses briefly while a tree or ore vein is being mined so the tool in hand cannot change during it.
- **Broken Tool Chain Mining**: Tree Capitator and Domino Ore Miner no longer keep breaking blocks after the tool has broken or has no durability left.

#### Improved & Balanced
- **Continuous Auto-Switch**: While you keep mining, aiming at a different kind of block, such as moving from stone to dirt, now switches to the best tool without stopping.

#### Improved & Balanced
- **Redstone Fortune**: Chain-mined Redstone Ore with Fortune now drops extra dust the way the single-block version does, instead of multiplying the whole stack.
- **Ore Experience**: Chain-mined ores now drop their normal experience as orbs when mined without Silk Touch.
- **Tree Capitator Limits**: Logs more than 8 blocks away from the broken log are ignored, so neighboring trees are far less likely to be felled together.
- **Player Build Protection**: Trees touching planks, doors, fences, glass, bricks, or storage blocks are left standing.
- **Game Rules**: Sleep skipping and the faster random tick speed are now set once when the world first loads, so you can change them afterward.

#### Fixed
- **Cobweb Shears Switch**: Looking at a cobweb no longer swaps shears into your hand; the swap now happens only when you hit the cobweb.
- **Creative Mode**: Chain mining and tree felling no longer wear down tools or drop items in Creative.
- **Melon and Pumpkin Stems**: Breaking a stem with an axe no longer fells nearby trees.
- **Accidental Hand Swap**: Quickly tapping sneak while moving or in the air, such as while bridging, no longer swaps your hands.
- **Leftover Light Blocks**: Moving light blocks left behind after a crash or reload are now removed the next time the world loads.

#### Fixed

#### Improved & Balanced

#### Fixed

#### Changed

#### Changed

#### Fixed

#### Added
- **Optional Mining Presets**: Added selectable Behavior Pack presets for Tree Capitator Only, Vein Miner Only, and Vanilla Mining (both disabled). The default pack keeps both features enabled. Other QoL features remain active in every preset.

#### Added & Improved
- **The Leaf Scan (Player-Placed Leaves Ignored)**: Overworld tree canopy detection now evaluates natural leaf growth. Decorative leaves harvested with shears and placed manually by players are recognized as custom decorations and completely ignored, preventing custom hedges, bushes, and decorative roof foliage from falsely triggering tree felling or getting destroyed. Only naturally grown leaves and Nether canopies validate the tree canopy.

#### Added
- **Mob Head Drops Balanced**: Standardized mob head drops (Zombie, Skeleton, Creeper, Piglin, Wither Skeleton, Ender Dragon, PvP Player) to a balanced 1.0% base drop chance (+0.5% per Looting level up to 2.5% max at Looting III).
- **Wandering Trader Collector Head Trades**: Adjusted head trade offering probability to a rare 2% spawn rate in collector trade pools, priced at 1 Diamond Block + 16 Emeralds per head.
- **Shulker Shell Drop Rate**: Adjusted Shulker Shell drops to 1 to 2 shells (yielding 2 to 3 with Looting enchantments).
- **Boss Leashing Immunity**: Removed leashing capability from the Warden, Wither, and Ender Dragon to maintain boss encounter integrity while preserving universal leashing on all 98 standard entities.
- **tool durability stop**: Tuned tool durability stop from 5 to 1 durability point, giving players maximum tool usage before emergency protection activates.
- **Stonecutter Woodcutter All 12 Woods**: Added full Stonecutter recipe support for Pale Oak (Logs to Planks, Slabs, Stairs, Fences, Fence Gates, and Trapdoors), completing support for all 12 wood variants in Minecraft Bedrock.

#### Changed

#### Added
- **Offhand Quick-Swap**: Double-sneak gesture or sneak+use in air to quickly swap Torches, Lanterns, Clocks, and Compasses between mainhand and offhand.

#### Added
- **Mob Head Trophy Drops**: 2.5% base drop chance on player kills for Zombie, Skeleton, Creeper, and Piglin heads.
- **Wandering Trader Collector Trades**: Rare head exchanges and biome flora trading.
- **Single-Player Sleep**: 1 player sleeping in a bed skips the night on multiplayer worlds and Realms.
- **Guaranteed Shulker Shells**: 2 shells guaranteed per Shulker kill.

#### Added
- **Stonecutter Woodcutter**: Cut all 11 wood types in the Stonecutter at fair 1:1 craft ratios (Planks, Slabs, Stairs, Fences, Gates).
- **Stackable Potions & Milk**: Potions, Splash Potions, Lingering Potions, and Milk Buckets stack up to 16 per inventory slot.

#### Added
- **Universal Leashing**: Support for leashing 101 mobs including Villagers, Golems, and pacified hostiles.
- **Spider Leash Locators**: Custom torso locator alignment for spiders and cave spiders.
- **Pet Friendly-Fire Immunity**: Tamed companions take zero damage from friendly sweeps, arrows, and explosions.
- **Fast Leaf Decay**: Floating leaves decay within 1 to 2 seconds after tree felling.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>1.0.x</b> (1 release)</summary>

### [1.0.0] - 2026-11-02

#### v1.3.x (v1.3.30)
- **Smoother Held Light**: The light from torches and lanterns in your hands now updates every tick, so it keeps up with you while moving and jumping.
- **Auto-Switch Only While Mining**: Auto-switch now acts only while you are hitting blocks and no longer changes your tool just because you are looking at something.
- **Light Flicker While Pillar Jumping**: Placing a block where your held light was no longer leaves you in the dark; the light moves back to you immediately.
- **Durability After Auto-Switch**: If auto-switch changes your tool at the same moment a tree or ore vein is chain mined, the tool you actually mined with is put back in your hand and takes the durability loss instead of the new tool.
- **Switch Delay After Breaking**: Auto-switch now waits a few ticks after any block breaks before changing your tool, so the tool you broke the block with keeps its durability loss.

</details>
```

```
import { world, system, EquipmentSlot, ItemStack, BlockPermutation } from "@minecraft/server";
import { MINING_OPTIONS } from "./mining-options.js";

const LOG_PREFIX = "[Vanilla QoL]";

const CONFIG = {
  SWAP_WINDOW_TICKS: 14,
  SWAP_COOLDOWN_TICKS: 8,
  LIGHT_UPDATE_TICKS: 1,
  IDLE_LIGHT_CHECK_TICKS: 5,
  STILL_SPEED_LIMIT: 0.03,

  AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT: 0,
  SWITCH_MARGIN: 3,
  TOOL_TIE_TOLERANCE: 1,
  SILK_BLOCK_BONUS: 60,
  LOW_DURABILITY_USES: 15,
  LOW_DURABILITY_PENALTY: 100,
  RAYCAST_DISTANCE: 6,
  RETRY_TICKS: 2,
  COMBAT_COOLDOWN_TICKS: 10,
  MINING_ACTIVE_TICKS: 10,
  BREAK_SWITCH_DELAY_TICKS: 2,
  SWAP_RESTORE_TICKS: 4,
  SWAP_BACK_TICKS: 30,
  TOOL_SEARCH_LAST_SLOT: 8,
  PROTECTED_SLOTS: [],
  WEB_CHECK_INTERVAL: 2,
  WEB_INTERACTION_WINDOW: 12,
  WEB_COMBAT_COOLDOWN: 40,

  TREE_CAPITATOR_ENABLED: MINING_OPTIONS.TREE_CAPITATOR_ENABLED,
  MAX_TREE_BLOCKS: 128,
  MAX_TREE_HEIGHT: 320,
  TREE_MAX_HORIZONTAL_SPREAD: 8,
  MATCH_TREE_SPECIES: true,

  DOMINO_ORE_MINER_ENABLED: MINING_OPTIONS.DOMINO_ORE_MINER_ENABLED,
  MAX_ORE_CLUSTER_SIZE: 64,
  MAX_ANCIENT_DEBRIS_CLUSTER_SIZE: 4,
  NETHER_GOLD_POLICY: "nether_gold",

  CHAIN_PAUSE_TICKS: 40,
  DROP_GROUP_SIZE: 5,
  XP_ORB_LIMIT: 10,

  DURABILITY_SAFETY_THRESHOLD: 0,
  ALERT_SOUND: "note.bass",
  ALERT_PITCH: 0.7,
  ALERT_VOLUME: 1.0,

  STARTUP_DELAY_TICKS: 40,
  RANDOM_TICK_SPEED: 4,
  SLEEP_PERCENTAGE: 0,
};

const SUPPORTED_OFFHAND_ITEMS = new Set([
  "minecraft:torch",
  "minecraft:soul_torch",
  "minecraft:redstone_torch",
  "minecraft:lantern",
  "minecraft:soul_lantern",
  "minecraft:clock",
  "minecraft:compass",
  "minecraft:recovery_compass",
]);

const LIGHT_LEVELS = {
  "minecraft:torch": 14,
  "minecraft:soul_torch": 10,
  "minecraft:redstone_torch": 7,
  "minecraft:lantern": 15,
  "minecraft:soul_lantern": 10,
  "minecraft:glowstone": 15,
  "minecraft:sea_lantern": 15,
  "minecraft:shroomlight": 15,
  "minecraft:lit_pumpkin": 15,
};

const qolPlayerState = new Map();

function getQolState(id) {
  let state = qolPlayerState.get(id);
  if (!state) {
    state = {
      sneakHeld: false,
      sneakCount: 0,
      sneakTimer: 0,
      lastSwapTick: -9999,
      lightDim: undefined,
      lightX: undefined,
      lightY: undefined,
      lightZ: undefined,
      lightLevel: 0,
    };
    qolPlayerState.set(id, state);
  }
  return state;
}

function isGameMode(player, mode) {
  try {
    return world.getPlayers({ gameMode: mode, name: player.name }).length > 0;
  } catch (e) {}
  try {
    return !!player.matches({ gameMode: mode });
  } catch (e) {}
  return false;
}

function shortId(typeId) {
  return typeId && typeId.startsWith("minecraft:") ? typeId.slice("minecraft:".length) : typeId;
}

function describeItem(item) {
  if (!item) return "Empty";
  const name = item.nameTag ? `"${item.nameTag}"` : shortId(item.typeId);
  return item.amount > 1 ? `${name} x${item.amount}` : name;
}

function getEquipment(player) {
  try {
    return player.getComponent("minecraft:equippable") || player.getComponent("equippable");
  } catch (e) {
    return undefined;
  }
}

function getContainer(player) {
  try {
    const inv = player.getComponent("minecraft:inventory") || player.getComponent("inventory");
    return inv ? inv.container : undefined;
  } catch (e) {
    return undefined;
  }
}

function cloneStack(item) {
  if (!item) return undefined;
  try {
    if (typeof item.clone === "function") return item.clone();
  } catch (e) {}
  try {
    const copy = new ItemStack(item.typeId, item.amount);
    if (item.nameTag) copy.nameTag = item.nameTag;
    return copy;
  } catch (e) {
    return undefined;
  }
}

function isPlainSupportedStack(item) {
  if (!item || !SUPPORTED_OFFHAND_ITEMS.has(item.typeId)) return false;
  try {
    if (item.nameTag) return false;
    if (item.getLore().length > 0) return false;
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

function offhandMatches(equipment, item) {
  const readBack = equipment.getEquipment(EquipmentSlot.Offhand);
  if (!item) return !readBack;
  if (!readBack || readBack.typeId !== item.typeId || readBack.amount !== item.amount) return false;
  if (SUPPORTED_OFFHAND_ITEMS.has(item.typeId)) {
    return (readBack.nameTag || "") === (item.nameTag || "");
  }
  return true;
}

function forceOffhand(player, item) {
  if (item && !isPlainSupportedStack(item)) return;
  const id = item ? shortId(item.typeId) : "air";
  const amount = item ? item.amount : 1;
  const commands = item
    ? [
        `replaceitem entity @s slot.weapon.offhand 0 ${id} ${amount}`,
        `replaceitem entity @s slot.weapon.offhand 0 ${item.typeId} ${amount}`,
        `item replace entity @s slot.weapon.offhand with ${id} ${amount}`,
      ]
    : [
        "replaceitem entity @s slot.weapon.offhand 0 air",
        "item replace entity @s slot.weapon.offhand with air",
      ];
  for (const cmd of commands) {
    try {
      player.runCommand(cmd);
    } catch (e) {}
  }
}

function writeOffhand(player, equipment, item) {
  if (item) {
    try {
      const copy = cloneStack(item);
      equipment.setEquipment(EquipmentSlot.Offhand, copy);
      if (offhandMatches(equipment, item)) return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  } else {
    try {
      equipment.setEquipment(EquipmentSlot.Offhand, undefined);
      if (offhandMatches(equipment, undefined)) return true;
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  forceOffhand(player, item);
  return offhandMatches(equipment, item);
}

function writeMainhand(player, equipment, item) {
  try {
    const accepted = equipment.setEquipment(EquipmentSlot.Mainhand, item ? cloneStack(item) : undefined);
    if (accepted !== false) return true;
  } catch (e) {}
  try {
    const container = getContainer(player);
    if (container) {
      container.setItem(player.selectedSlotIndex, item ? cloneStack(item) : undefined);
      return true;
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return false;
}

function swapHands(player) {
  const state = getQolState(player.id);
  if (system.currentTick - state.lastSwapTick < CONFIG.SWAP_COOLDOWN_TICKS) return false;

  const equipment = getEquipment(player);
  if (!equipment) return false;

  let main;
  let off;
  try {
    main = equipment.getEquipment(EquipmentSlot.Mainhand);
    off = equipment.getEquipment(EquipmentSlot.Offhand);
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }

  const mainAllowed = main && SUPPORTED_OFFHAND_ITEMS.has(main.typeId);
  const offAllowed = off && SUPPORTED_OFFHAND_ITEMS.has(off.typeId);

  if (!mainAllowed && !offAllowed) {
    return false;
  }

  const mainCopy = cloneStack(main);
  const offCopy = cloneStack(off);

  if (!writeOffhand(player, equipment, mainCopy)) {
    writeOffhand(player, equipment, offCopy);
    writeMainhand(player, equipment, mainCopy);
    return false;
  }

  if (!writeMainhand(player, equipment, offCopy)) {
    writeOffhand(player, equipment, offCopy);
    writeMainhand(player, equipment, mainCopy);
    return false;
  }

  state.lastSwapTick = system.currentTick;

  try {
    player.playSound("armor.equip_generic", { pitch: 1.15, volume: 0.85 });
    player.onScreenDisplay.setActionBar(
      `§6Offhand: §f${describeItem(mainCopy)} §8| §eMain: §f${describeItem(offCopy)}`
    );
  } catch (e) {}

  return true;
}

function isLightBlock(typeId) {
  return typeId === "minecraft:light_block" || (typeId && typeId.startsWith("minecraft:light_block"));
}

function canHoldLight(block) {
  if (!block) return false;
  try {
    if (block.isAir) return true;
    return isLightBlock(block.typeId);
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
}

let lightsCleaned = false;

function persistLights() {
  if (!lightsCleaned) return;
  try {
    const list = [];
    for (const st of qolPlayerState.values()) {
      if (st.lightDim !== undefined && st.lightX !== undefined) {
        list.push([st.lightDim.id, st.lightX, st.lightY, st.lightZ]);
      }
    }
    world.setDynamicProperty("qol:lights", JSON.stringify(list));
  } catch (e) {}
}

function clearPlacedLight(state) {
  if (!state || state.lightDim === undefined || state.lightX === undefined) return;
  try {
    const block = state.lightDim.getBlock({ x: state.lightX, y: state.lightY, z: state.lightZ });
    if (block && isLightBlock(block.typeId)) {
      block.setPermutation(BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:air"));
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  state.lightDim = undefined;
  state.lightX = undefined;
  state.lightY = undefined;
  state.lightZ = undefined;
  state.lightLevel = 0;
  persistLights();
}

function placeLightBlock(dim, x, y, z, level) {
  try {
    const block = dim.getBlock({ x, y, z });
    if (!canHoldLight(block)) return false;
    try {
      block.setPermutation(BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:light_block", { block_light_level: level }));
      return true;
    } catch {
      try {
        block.setPermutation(BlockPermutation.resolve(`minecraft:light_block_${level}`));
        return true;
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function getHeldLightLevel(main, off) {
  const offLevel = off ? LIGHT_LEVELS[off.typeId] || 0 : 0;
  const mainLevel = main ? LIGHT_LEVELS[main.typeId] || 0 : 0;
  return Math.max(offLevel, mainLevel);
}

function updatePlayerLight(player, state) {
  const equipment = getEquipment(player);
  if (!equipment) {
    clearPlacedLight(state);
    return;
  }

  let main;
  let off;
  try {
    main = equipment.getEquipment(EquipmentSlot.Mainhand);
    off = equipment.getEquipment(EquipmentSlot.Offhand);
  } catch (e) {
    clearPlacedLight(state);
    return;
  }

  const level = getHeldLightLevel(main, off);
  if (!level) {
    clearPlacedLight(state);
    return;
  }

  const dim = player.dimension;
  const x = Math.floor(player.location.x);
  let y = Math.floor(player.location.y + 0.2);
  const z = Math.floor(player.location.z);

  if (
    state.lightDim === dim &&
    state.lightX === x &&
    state.lightY === y &&
    state.lightZ === z &&
    state.lightLevel === level
  ) {
    return;
  }

  let placed = placeLightBlock(dim, x, y, z, level);
  if (!placed) {
    y += 1;
    placed = placeLightBlock(dim, x, y, z, level);
  }
  if (!placed) return;

  if (
    state.lightDim &&
    (state.lightDim !== dim || state.lightX !== x || state.lightY !== y || state.lightZ !== z)
  ) {
    try {
      const old = state.lightDim.getBlock({ x: state.lightX, y: state.lightY, z: state.lightZ });
      if (old && isLightBlock(old.typeId)) {
        old.setPermutation(BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:air"));
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  state.lightDim = dim;
  state.lightX = x;
  state.lightY = y;
  state.lightZ = z;
  state.lightLevel = level;
  persistLights();
}

const ToolCategory = {
  PICKAXE: "pickaxe",
  AXE: "axe",
  SHOVEL: "shovel",
  LEAVES: "leaves",
  WEB: "web",
  SHEARS_OR_SWORD: "shears_or_sword",
  HOE: "hoe",
  WEAPON: "weapon",
  SILK: "silk",
};

const TIER_SCORES = {
  netherite: 50,
  diamond: 40,
  iron: 30,
  stone: 20,
  golden: 15,
  gold: 15,
  wooden: 10,
  wood: 10,
};

const IGNORED_BLOCKS = new Set([
  "air", "cave_air", "void_air", "water", "flowing_water", "lava", "flowing_lava",
  "bedrock", "barrier", "structure_void", "light_block", "portal", "end_portal",
  "end_portal_frame", "end_gateway",
  "redstone_torch", "unlit_redstone_torch", "redstone_wire",
]);

const NON_COMBAT_ENTITIES = new Set([
  "item", "arrow", "spectral_arrow", "xp_orb", "experience_orb", "snowball", "egg",
  "splash_potion", "lingering_potion", "ender_pearl", "eye_of_ender_signal",
  "lightning_bolt", "armor_stand", "painting", "item_frame", "glow_item_frame",
  "leash_knot", "boat", "chest_boat", "minecart", "chest_minecart", "hopper_minecart",
  "tnt_minecart", "command_block_minecart", "tnt", "falling_block",
]);

const recentCombat = new Map();
const pendingSwaps = new Map();
const webInteraction = new Map();

function normalizeId(id) {
  return (id ?? "").replace(/^minecraft:/, "").toLowerCase();
}

function getMaterialTier(id) {
  for (const [tier, score] of Object.entries(TIER_SCORES)) {
    if (id.includes(tier)) return score;
  }
  return 0;
}

function readDurability(item) {
  try {
    const dur = item?.getComponent("minecraft:durability") || item?.getComponent("durability");
    if (!dur) return null;
    const max = dur.maxDurability;
    const damage = dur.damage;
    return {
      remaining: Math.max(0, max - damage),
      fraction: max > 0 ? (max - damage) / max : 1,
    };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function readEnchantments(item) {
  const result = { efficiency: 0, fortune: 0, silk: 0, sharpness: 0, mending: 0 };
  try {
    const enchants = item?.getComponent("minecraft:enchantable") || item?.getComponent("enchantable");
    if (!enchants) return result;
    for (const ench of enchants.getEnchantments()) {
      const type = (ench.type?.id || ench.id || "").toLowerCase();
      if (type.includes("efficiency")) result.efficiency = ench.level;
      if (type.includes("fortune")) result.fortune = ench.level;
      if (type.includes("silk_touch")) result.silk = ench.level;
      if (type.includes("sharpness")) result.sharpness = ench.level;
      if (type.includes("mending")) result.mending = ench.level;
    }
  } catch {}
  return result;
}

function needsRepair(item) {
  if (!item) return false;
  const durability = readDurability(item);
  if (!durability || durability.fraction >= 1) return false;
  return readEnchantments(item).mending > 0;
}

function scoreItem(item, category, slot, blockId) {
  if (!item?.typeId) return -Infinity;
  const id = normalizeId(item.typeId);
  let score = 0;

  switch (category) {
    case ToolCategory.PICKAXE:
      if (!id.endsWith("_pickaxe")) return -Infinity;
      score = getMaterialTier(id);
      break;
    case ToolCategory.AXE:
      if (!id.endsWith("_axe")) return -Infinity;
      score = getMaterialTier(id);
      break;
    case ToolCategory.SHOVEL:
      if (!id.endsWith("_shovel")) return -Infinity;
      score = getMaterialTier(id);
      break;
    case ToolCategory.HOE:
      if (!id.endsWith("_hoe")) return -Infinity;
      score = getMaterialTier(id);
      break;
    case ToolCategory.LEAVES:
      if (id.includes("shears")) score = 100;
      else if (id.endsWith("_hoe")) score = 50 + getMaterialTier(id);
      else if (id.endsWith("_sword")) score = 20 + getMaterialTier(id);
      else return -Infinity;
      break;
    case ToolCategory.WEB:
      if (id.includes("shears")) score = 100;
      else if (id.endsWith("_sword")) score = 50 + getMaterialTier(id);
      else return -Infinity;
      break;
    case ToolCategory.SHEARS_OR_SWORD:
      if (id.includes("shears")) score = 100;
      else if (id.endsWith("_sword")) score = 50 + getMaterialTier(id);
      else return -Infinity;
      break;
    case ToolCategory.SILK:
      if (!/_(pickaxe|axe|shovel|hoe)$/.test(id)) return -Infinity;
      if (readEnchantments(item).silk <= 0) return -Infinity;
      score = getMaterialTier(id);
      break;
    case ToolCategory.WEAPON:
      if (id.endsWith("_sword")) score = 100 + getMaterialTier(id);
      else if (id.endsWith("_axe")) score = 80 + getMaterialTier(id);
      else if (id.endsWith("_mace")) score = 90;
      else return -Infinity;
      break;
    default:
      return -Infinity;
  }

  const enchants = readEnchantments(item);
  score += enchants.efficiency * 2;
  score += enchants.sharpness * 3;

  if (category === ToolCategory.PICKAXE && blockId) {
    if (blockId.endsWith("_ore")) {
      score += enchants.fortune * 1.5;
      if (enchants.silk > 0) score -= 8;
    }
  }

  if (category === ToolCategory.AXE && blockId === "bookshelf" && enchants.silk > 0) {
    score += CONFIG.SILK_BLOCK_BONUS;
  }

  const durability = readDurability(item);
  if (durability) {
    if (durability.remaining <= CONFIG.LOW_DURABILITY_USES) {
      score -= CONFIG.LOW_DURABILITY_PENALTY;
    } else {
      score += durability.fraction;
    }
  }

  return score;
}

function getRequiredToolCategory(typeId) {
  if (!typeId) return null;
  const id = normalizeId(typeId);
  if (IGNORED_BLOCKS.has(id)) return null;

  if (
    id === "glass" || id === "glass_pane" || id === "tinted_glass" ||
    id === "stained_glass" || id === "stained_glass_pane" ||
    id.endsWith("_stained_glass") || id.endsWith("_stained_glass_pane") ||
    id === "ice" || id === "packed_ice" || id === "blue_ice"
  ) {
    return ToolCategory.SILK;
  }

  if (id === "web" || id.includes("cobweb")) return ToolCategory.WEB;
  if (id.includes("mangrove_roots")) return ToolCategory.AXE;

  if (id.includes("sandstone") || id.includes("mud_brick")) return ToolCategory.PICKAXE;

  if (
    id.endsWith("concrete_powder") || id.includes("sand") || id.includes("gravel") ||
    id.includes("clay") || id.includes("dirt") || id === "grass_block" ||
    id.includes("podzol") || id.includes("mycelium") || id.includes("farmland") ||
    id.includes("mud") || id.includes("soul_soil") || id.includes("snow")
  ) {
    return ToolCategory.SHOVEL;
  }

  if (id === "ender_chest") return ToolCategory.PICKAXE;
  if (id.includes("leaves")) return ToolCategory.LEAVES;

  if (
    id.includes("wool") || id.includes("vine") || id.includes("fern") ||
    id === "tallgrass" || id === "seagrass" || id === "hanging_roots" ||
    id === "deadbush" || id === "tripwire"
  ) {
    return ToolCategory.SHEARS_OR_SWORD;
  }

  if (
    id === "hay_block" || id === "target" || id === "sponge" || id === "wet_sponge" ||
    id.includes("sculk") || id.includes("moss_block") || id.includes("moss_carpet") ||
    id.includes("wart_block") || id === "shroomlight"
  ) {
    return ToolCategory.HOE;
  }

  if (
    id.endsWith("_log") || id.endsWith("_wood") || id.endsWith("_stem") || id.endsWith("_hyphae") ||
    id.startsWith("stripped_") || id.includes("planks") || id.includes("crafting_table") ||
    id.includes("cartography_table") || id.includes("fletching_table") || id.includes("smithing_table") ||
    id.includes("loom") || id.includes("composter") || id === "chest" || id === "trapped_chest" ||
    id === "barrel" || id.includes("bookshelf") || id === "lectern" || id.includes("pumpkin") ||
    id.includes("melon") || id === "cocoa" || id.includes("beehive") || id === "bee_nest" ||
    id.includes("ladder") || id.includes("sign") || id.includes("mushroom_stem") ||
    id.includes("mushroom_block") || id === "jukebox" || id === "daylight_detector" ||
    id === "note_block" || id.includes("bamboo_block") || id.includes("bamboo_mosaic") ||
    (id.endsWith("_fence") && !id.includes("nether_brick")) || id.endsWith("_fence_gate")
  ) {
    return ToolCategory.AXE;
  }

  const woodMaterials = [
    "oak", "spruce", "birch", "jungle", "acacia", "dark_oak",
    "mangrove", "cherry", "bamboo", "crimson", "warped", "pale_oak",
  ];
  if (
    woodMaterials.some((mat) => id.includes(mat)) && !id.includes("petrified") &&
    (id.endsWith("_door") || id.endsWith("_trapdoor") || id.endsWith("_button") ||
     id.endsWith("_pressure_plate") || id.endsWith("_stairs") || id.endsWith("_slab"))
  ) {
    return ToolCategory.AXE;
  }

  if (
    id.includes("stone") || id.includes("cobble") || id.includes("deepslate") ||
    id.includes("ore") || id.includes("granite") || id.includes("diorite") ||
    id.includes("andesite") || id.includes("tuff") || id.includes("calcite") ||
    id.includes("basalt") || id.includes("blackstone") || id.includes("obsidian") ||
    id.includes("ancient_debris") || id.includes("brick") || id.includes("terracotta") ||
    (id.includes("concrete") && !id.endsWith("concrete_powder")) || id.includes("sandstone") ||
    id.includes("prismarine") || id.includes("netherrack") || id.includes("end_stone") ||
    id.includes("purpur") || id.includes("magma") || id.includes("copper") ||
    id.includes("iron") || id.includes("gold") || id.includes("diamond") ||
    id.includes("emerald") || id.includes("lapis") || id.includes("redstone") ||
    id.includes("netherite") || id.includes("amethyst") || id.includes("dripstone") ||
    id.includes("furnace") || id.includes("smoker") || id.includes("hopper") ||
    id.includes("dispenser") || id.includes("dropper") || id.includes("cauldron") ||
    id.includes("anvil") || id.includes("enchanting_table") || id.includes("brewing_stand") ||
    id.includes("grindstone") || id.includes("stonecutter") || id.includes("bell") ||
    id.includes("lantern") || id.includes("chain") || id.includes("spawner") ||
    id.includes("vault") || id.includes("crafter")
  ) {
    return ToolCategory.PICKAXE;
  }

  return null;
}

function switchPlayerSlot1Tool(player, category, blockTypeId) {
  if (!player || player.selectedSlotIndex !== CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT) {
    return false;
  }
  if (system.currentTick < (chainPauseUntil.get(player.id) ?? 0)) return false;

  const container = getContainer(player);
  if (!container) return false;

  const blockId = normalizeId(blockTypeId);
  const currentScore = scoreItem(container.getItem(CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT), category, CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT, blockId);

  let bestSlot = -1;
  let bestScore = -Infinity;
  let bestItem;

  const lastSearchSlot = Math.min(container.size - 1, CONFIG.TOOL_SEARCH_LAST_SLOT);
  for (let slot = 1; slot <= lastSearchSlot; slot++) {
    if (CONFIG.PROTECTED_SLOTS.includes(slot)) continue;
    const item = container.getItem(slot);
    if (!item) continue;
    const score = scoreItem(item, category, slot, blockId);
    const tiedRepair =
      bestItem !== undefined &&
      Math.abs(score - bestScore) <= CONFIG.TOOL_TIE_TOLERANCE &&
      needsRepair(item) &&
      !needsRepair(bestItem);
    if (score > bestScore || tiedRepair) {
      bestScore = score;
      bestSlot = slot;
      bestItem = item;
    }
  }

  if (bestSlot === -1 || bestScore === -Infinity) return false;

  const currentItem = container.getItem(CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT);
  const repairSwap =
    currentScore !== -Infinity &&
    needsRepair(bestItem) &&
    !needsRepair(currentItem) &&
    Math.abs(bestScore - currentScore) <= CONFIG.TOOL_TIE_TOLERANCE;
  if (currentScore !== -Infinity && bestScore < currentScore + CONFIG.SWITCH_MARGIN && !repairSwap) return false;

  try {
    const record = swapBack.get(player.id);
    if (record) {
      swapBack.delete(player.id);
      if (isSwapBackValid(container, record)) {
        container.swapItems(record.slot, CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT, container);
        if (bestSlot === record.slot) {
          lastSwap.set(player.id, { tick: system.currentTick, slot: record.slot });
          return true;
        }
      }
    }
    const originalItem = container.getItem(CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT);
    container.swapItems(bestSlot, CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT, container);
    swapBack.set(player.id, {
      slot: bestSlot,
      toolTypeId: container.getItem(CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT)?.typeId,
      originalTypeId: originalItem?.typeId,
    });
    lastSwap.set(player.id, { tick: system.currentTick, slot: bestSlot });
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function isSwapBackValid(container, record) {
  return (
    container.getItem(CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT)?.typeId === record.toolTypeId &&
    container.getItem(record.slot)?.typeId === record.originalTypeId
  );
}

function restoreSwappedItem(player) {
  const record = swapBack.get(player.id);
  if (!record) return;
  swapBack.delete(player.id);
  if (player.selectedSlotIndex === record.slot) return;
  const container = getContainer(player);
  if (!container || !isSwapBackValid(container, record)) return;
  try {
    container.swapItems(record.slot, CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT, container);
  } catch (e) {}
}

function isCombatTarget(entity) {
  if (!entity?.typeId) return false;
  const id = normalizeId(entity.typeId);
  if (NON_COMBAT_ENTITIES.has(id)) return false;
  try {
    return id === "player" || !!entity.getComponent("minecraft:health");
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function isWeb(block) {
  if (!block?.typeId) return false;
  const id = normalizeId(block.typeId);
  return id === "web" || id.includes("cobweb");
}

function blockKey(block) {
  if (!block) return "";
  const { x, y, z } = block.location;
  return `${block.typeId}@${x},${y},${z}`;
}

function clearPendingSwap(playerId) {
  const runId = pendingSwaps.get(playerId);
  if (runId !== undefined) {
    system.clearRun(runId);
    pendingSwaps.delete(playerId);
  }
}

function scheduleSwapRetry(player, category, blockTypeId) {
  clearPendingSwap(player.id);
  const runId = system.runTimeout(() => {
    pendingSwaps.delete(player.id);
    try {
      if (player.selectedSlotIndex !== CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT) return;
      switchPlayerSlot1Tool(player, category, blockTypeId);
    } catch {}
  }, CONFIG.RETRY_TICKS);
  pendingSwaps.set(player.id, runId);
}

function getTargetBlock(player) {
  try {
    return player.getBlockFromViewDirection({
      maxDistance: CONFIG.RAYCAST_DISTANCE,
      includeLiquidBlocks: false,
      includePassableBlocks: true,
    })?.block;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

function getMainhandTool(player) {
  try {
    const eq = getEquipment(player);
    return eq ? eq.getEquipment(EquipmentSlot.Mainhand) : undefined;
  } catch (e) {
    return undefined;
  }
}

function checkToolSafety(player) {
  if (isGameMode(player, "creative")) return { safe: true, remaining: 9999 };
  const tool = getMainhandTool(player);
  if (!tool) return { safe: false, remaining: 0 };

  try {
    const durComp = tool.getComponent("minecraft:durability") || tool.getComponent("durability");
    if (!durComp) return { safe: true, remaining: 9999 };

    const remaining = durComp.maxDurability - durComp.damage - getPendingToolDamage(player);
    if (remaining <= CONFIG.DURABILITY_SAFETY_THRESHOLD) {
      return { safe: false, remaining };
    }
    return { safe: true, remaining };
  } catch (e) {
    return { safe: true, remaining: 9999 };
  }
}

const pendingToolDamage = new Map();

function getPendingToolDamage(player) {
  const entry = pendingToolDamage.get(player.id);
  return entry ? entry.damage : 0;
}

function applyToolDurabilityDamage(player) {
  if (isGameMode(player, "creative")) return;
  const container = getContainer(player);
  if (!container) return;

  const slot = player.selectedSlotIndex;
  const tool = container.getItem(slot);
  if (!tool) return;

  try {
    const durComp = tool.getComponent("minecraft:durability") || tool.getComponent("durability");
    if (!durComp) return;

    let unbreakingLevel = 0;
    try {
      const enchComp = tool.getComponent("minecraft:enchantable") || tool.getComponent("enchantable");
      if (enchComp) {
        for (const ench of enchComp.getEnchantments()) {
          const enchId = (ench.type?.id || ench.id || "").toLowerCase();
          if (enchId.includes("unbreaking")) {
            unbreakingLevel = ench.level;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    const shouldDamage = unbreakingLevel > 0
      ? Math.random() < 1 / (unbreakingLevel + 1)
      : true;
    if (!shouldDamage) return;

    let entry = pendingToolDamage.get(player.id);
    if (!entry || entry.slot !== slot || entry.typeId !== tool.typeId) {
      entry = { slot, typeId: tool.typeId, damage: 0 };
      pendingToolDamage.set(player.id, entry);
    }
    entry.damage += 1;
  } catch (e) {}
}

function flushToolDamage(player) {
  const entry = pendingToolDamage.get(player.id);
  pendingToolDamage.delete(player.id);
  if (!entry || entry.damage <= 0) return;

  system.run(() => {
    try {
      if (!player.isValid()) return;
      const container = getContainer(player);
      if (!container) return;

      const tool = container.getItem(entry.slot);
      if (!tool || tool.typeId !== entry.typeId) return;

      const durComp = tool.getComponent("minecraft:durability") || tool.getComponent("durability");
      if (!durComp) return;

      durComp.damage = Math.min(durComp.damage + entry.damage, durComp.maxDurability);
      container.setItem(entry.slot, tool);
    } catch (e) {}
  });
}

function notifyToolProtection(player, remainingDurability) {
  try {
    player.playSound(CONFIG.ALERT_SOUND, {
      pitch: CONFIG.ALERT_PITCH,
      volume: CONFIG.ALERT_VOLUME,
    });
    player.onScreenDisplay.setActionBar(
      `§e[Tool Protection] §cStopped mining to save tool! §6(${remainingDurability} durability left)`
    );
  } catch (e) {}
}

function notifyTreeTooLarge(player) {
  try {
    player.onScreenDisplay.setActionBar("§e[Tree Capitator] §6Tree too large, some logs were left standing");
  } catch (e) {}
}

const AXE_IDENTIFIERS = new Set([
  "minecraft:wooden_axe", "minecraft:stone_axe", "minecraft:iron_axe",
  "minecraft:golden_axe", "minecraft:diamond_axe", "minecraft:netherite_axe",
]);

function isAxe(typeId) {
  if (!typeId) return false;
  return AXE_IDENTIFIERS.has(typeId) || typeId.endsWith("_axe");
}

const ELIGIBLE_LOGS = new Set([
  "minecraft:oak_log", "minecraft:stripped_oak_log", "minecraft:oak_wood", "minecraft:stripped_oak_wood",
  "minecraft:spruce_log", "minecraft:stripped_spruce_log", "minecraft:spruce_wood", "minecraft:stripped_spruce_wood",
  "minecraft:birch_log", "minecraft:stripped_birch_log", "minecraft:birch_wood", "minecraft:stripped_birch_wood",
  "minecraft:jungle_log", "minecraft:stripped_jungle_log", "minecraft:jungle_wood", "minecraft:stripped_jungle_wood",
  "minecraft:acacia_log", "minecraft:stripped_acacia_log", "minecraft:acacia_wood", "minecraft:stripped_acacia_wood",
  "minecraft:dark_oak_log", "minecraft:stripped_dark_oak_log", "minecraft:dark_oak_wood", "minecraft:stripped_dark_oak_wood",
  "minecraft:mangrove_log", "minecraft:stripped_mangrove_log", "minecraft:mangrove_wood", "minecraft:stripped_mangrove_wood",
  "minecraft:mangrove_roots", "minecraft:muddy_mangrove_roots",
  "minecraft:cherry_log", "minecraft:stripped_cherry_log", "minecraft:cherry_wood", "minecraft:stripped_cherry_wood",
  "minecraft:pale_oak_log", "minecraft:stripped_pale_oak_log", "minecraft:pale_oak_wood", "minecraft:stripped_pale_oak_wood",
  "minecraft:crimson_stem", "minecraft:stripped_crimson_stem", "minecraft:crimson_hyphae", "minecraft:stripped_crimson_hyphae",
  "minecraft:warped_stem", "minecraft:stripped_warped_stem", "minecraft:warped_hyphae", "minecraft:stripped_warped_hyphae",
]);

function isEligibleLog(blockId) {
  if (!blockId) return false;
  if (ELIGIBLE_LOGS.has(blockId)) return true;
  return /(_log|_wood|_hyphae|mangrove_roots|(crimson|warped)_stem)$/i.test(blockId);
}

function getWoodSpecies(typeId) {
  if (!typeId) return null;
  const match = typeId.match(/(dark_oak|pale_oak|oak|spruce|birch|jungle|acacia|mangrove|cherry|crimson|warped)/i);
  return match ? match[1].toLowerCase() : null;
}

function isMatchingLog(blockId, targetSpecies) {
  if (!isEligibleLog(blockId)) return false;
  if (!CONFIG.MATCH_TREE_SPECIES || !targetSpecies) return true;
  const species = getWoodSpecies(blockId);
  return !species || species === targetSpecies;
}

function isTreeCanopy(dimension, blocks, targetSpecies) {
  if (!blocks || blocks.length === 0) return false;
  const candidates = [...blocks].sort((a, b) => b.y - a.y).slice(0, 8);
  for (const pos of candidates) {
    for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
      for (let dz = -2; dz <= 2; dz++) {
        for (let dy = 0; dy <= 2; dy++) {
          try {
            const b = dimension.getBlock({ x: pos.x + dx, y: pos.y + dy, z: pos.z + dz });
            if (!b) continue;

            if ((targetSpecies === "crimson" || targetSpecies === "warped") &&
                (b.typeId.includes("wart_block") || b.typeId.includes("shroomlight"))) {
              return true;
            }

            if (b.typeId.includes("leaves")) {
              const permutation = b.permutation;
              const isPersistent = permutation?.getState("persistent_bit");
              if (isPersistent === true) {
                continue;
              }
              return true;
            }
          } catch (e) {}
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false;
}

const PLAYER_BUILD_PATTERN = /(planks|stairs|slab|door|trapdoor|glass|brick|fence|(^|_)bed$|crafting_table|chest|barrel|furnace|concrete|wool|carpet|bookshelf)/;

function isNearPlayerBuild(dimension, blocks, startLoc) {
  const checked = new Set();
  const positions = [startLoc, ...blocks];
  for (const pos of positions) {
    for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
      for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
        for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
          const x = pos.x + dx;
          const y = pos.y + dy;
          const z = pos.z + dz;
          const key = `${x},${y},${z}`;
          if (checked.has(key)) continue;
          checked.add(key);
          try {
            const b = dimension.getBlock({ x, y, z });
            if (!b) continue;
            const builtId = normalizeId(b.typeId);
            if (builtId !== "moss_carpet" && PLAYER_BUILD_PATTERN.test(builtId)) return true;
          } catch (e) {}
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return false;
}

function removeBlockAt(dimension, pos) {
  const block = dimension.getBlock({ x: pos.x, y: pos.y, z: pos.z });
  if (!block) return undefined;
  const typeId = block.typeId;
  let waterlogged = false;
  try {
    waterlogged = block.isWaterlogged === true;
  } catch (e) {}
  block.setPermutation(BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:air"));
  if (waterlogged) {
    try {
      block.setWaterlogged(true);
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  return typeId;
}

function addGroupedDrop(drops, pos, typeId, count) {
  const size = CONFIG.DROP_GROUP_SIZE;
  const key = `${Math.floor(pos.x / size)},${Math.floor(pos.y / size)},${Math.floor(pos.z / size)}|${typeId}`;
  const entry = drops.get(key);
  if (entry) {
    entry.count += count;
  } else {
    drops.set(key, { typeId, count, x: pos.x, y: pos.y, z: pos.z });
  }
}

function spawnGroupedDrops(dimension, drops) {
  for (const entry of drops.values()) {
    let maxStack = 64;
    try {
      maxStack = new ItemStack(entry.typeId, 1).maxAmount || 64;
    } catch (e) {}
    let remaining = entry.count;
    while (remaining > 0) {
      const amount = Math.min(remaining, maxStack);
      try {
        dimension.spawnItem(new ItemStack(entry.typeId, amount), {
          x: entry.x + 0.5,
          y: entry.y + 0.5,
          z: entry.z + 0.5,
        });
      } catch (e) {}
      remaining -= amount;
    }
  }
}

function executeTreeCapitator(player, dimension, startLoc, startBlockId, onComplete) {
  if (typeof startBlockId === "function") {
    onComplete = startBlockId;
    startBlockId = null;
  }
  if (!CONFIG.TREE_CAPITATOR_ENABLED) {
    if (onComplete) onComplete();
    return;
  }

  const targetSpecies = startBlockId ? getWoodSpecies(startBlockId) : null;
  const visited = new Set();
  visited.add(`${startLoc.x},${startLoc.y},${startLoc.z}`);

  const blocksToBreak = [];
  const queue = [{ x: startLoc.x, y: startLoc.y, z: startLoc.z }];

  while (queue.length > 0 && blocksToBreak.length < CONFIG.MAX_TREE_BLOCKS) {
    const cur = queue.shift();

    for (let dy = 0; dy <= 1; dy++) {
      for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
        for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
          if (dx === 0 && dy === 0 && dz === 0) continue;

          const nx = cur.x + dx;
          const ny = cur.y + dy;
          const nz = cur.z + dz;

          if (ny < startLoc.y) continue;
          if (ny > startLoc.y + CONFIG.MAX_TREE_HEIGHT) continue;
          if (
            Math.abs(nx - startLoc.x) > CONFIG.TREE_MAX_HORIZONTAL_SPREAD ||
            Math.abs(nz - startLoc.z) > CONFIG.TREE_MAX_HORIZONTAL_SPREAD
          ) continue;

          const key = `${nx},${ny},${nz}`;
          if (visited.has(key)) continue;
          visited.add(key);

          try {
            const block = dimension.getBlock({ x: nx, y: ny, z: nz });
            if (block && isMatchingLog(block.typeId, targetSpecies)) {
              const logPos = { x: nx, y: ny, z: nz };
              blocksToBreak.push(logPos);
              queue.push(logPos);
              if (blocksToBreak.length >= CONFIG.MAX_TREE_BLOCKS) break;
            }
          } catch (e) {}
        }
        if (blocksToBreak.length >= CONFIG.MAX_TREE_BLOCKS) break;
      }
      if (blocksToBreak.length >= CONFIG.MAX_TREE_BLOCKS) break;
    }
  }

  if (blocksToBreak.length === 0) {
    if (onComplete) onComplete();
    return;
  }

  if (!isTreeCanopy(dimension, blocksToBreak, targetSpecies)) {
    if (onComplete) onComplete();
    return;
  }

  if (isNearPlayerBuild(dimension, blocksToBreak, startLoc)) {
    if (onComplete) onComplete();
    return;
  }

  const capped = blocksToBreak.length >= CONFIG.MAX_TREE_BLOCKS;
  const creative = isGameMode(player, "creative");
  const drops = new Map();
  for (const pos of blocksToBreak) {
    if (!player || !player.isValid()) break;

    const safety = checkToolSafety(player);
    if (!safety.safe) {
      notifyToolProtection(player, safety.remaining);
      break;
    }

    try {
      const brokenId = removeBlockAt(dimension, pos);
      if (brokenId && !creative) addGroupedDrop(drops, pos, brokenId, 1);
      applyToolDurabilityDamage(player);
    } catch (err) {}
  }
  spawnGroupedDrops(dimension, drops);
  if (capped) notifyTreeTooLarge(player);

  if (onComplete) onComplete();
}

const PICKAXE_TIERS = {
  "minecraft:wooden_pickaxe": 1,
  "minecraft:golden_pickaxe": 1,
  "minecraft:stone_pickaxe": 2,
  "minecraft:iron_pickaxe": 3,
  "minecraft:diamond_pickaxe": 4,
  "minecraft:netherite_pickaxe": 5,
};

function isPickaxe(typeId) {
  if (!typeId) return false;
  return Boolean(PICKAXE_TIERS[typeId]) || typeId.endsWith("_pickaxe");
}

function getPickaxeTier(typeId) {
  return PICKAXE_TIERS[typeId] || (typeId?.endsWith("_pickaxe") ? 3 : 0);
}

const ORE_DEFINITIONS = {
  "minecraft:coal_ore": { category: "coal", minTier: 1, dropItem: "minecraft:coal" },
  "minecraft:deepslate_coal_ore": { category: "coal", minTier: 1, dropItem: "minecraft:coal" },
  "minecraft:iron_ore": { category: "iron", minTier: 2, dropItem: "minecraft:raw_iron" },
  "minecraft:deepslate_iron_ore": { category: "iron", minTier: 2, dropItem: "minecraft:raw_iron" },
  "minecraft:copper_ore": { category: "copper", minTier: 2, dropItem: "minecraft:raw_copper", minDrop: 2, maxDrop: 5 },
  "minecraft:deepslate_copper_ore": { category: "copper", minTier: 2, dropItem: "minecraft:raw_copper", minDrop: 2, maxDrop: 5 },
  "minecraft:lapis_ore": { category: "lapis", minTier: 2, dropItem: "minecraft:lapis_lazuli", minDrop: 4, maxDrop: 9 },
  "minecraft:deepslate_lapis_ore": { category: "lapis", minTier: 2, dropItem: "minecraft:lapis_lazuli", minDrop: 4, maxDrop: 9 },
  "minecraft:gold_ore": { category: "gold", minTier: 3, dropItem: "minecraft:raw_gold" },
  "minecraft:deepslate_gold_ore": { category: "gold", minTier: 3, dropItem: "minecraft:raw_gold" },
  "minecraft:nether_gold_ore": { category: CONFIG.NETHER_GOLD_POLICY, minTier: 1, dropItem: "minecraft:gold_nugget", minDrop: 2, maxDrop: 6 },
  "minecraft:redstone_ore": { category: "redstone", minTier: 3, dropItem: "minecraft:redstone", minDrop: 4, maxDrop: 5 },

  "minecraft:deepslate_redstone_ore": { category: "redstone", minTier: 3, dropItem: "minecraft:redstone", minDrop: 4, maxDrop: 5 },
  "minecraft:lit_deepslate_redstone_ore": { category: "redstone", minTier: 3, dropItem: "minecraft:redstone", minDrop: 4, maxDrop: 5 },
  "minecraft:diamond_ore": { category: "diamond", minTier: 3, dropItem: "minecraft:diamond" },
  "minecraft:deepslate_diamond_ore": { category: "diamond", minTier: 3, dropItem: "minecraft:diamond" },
  "minecraft:emerald_ore": { category: "emerald", minTier: 3, dropItem: "minecraft:emerald" },
  "minecraft:deepslate_emerald_ore": { category: "emerald", minTier: 3, dropItem: "minecraft:emerald" },
  "minecraft:quartz_ore": { category: "quartz", minTier: 1, dropItem: "minecraft:quartz" },
  "minecraft:nether_quartz_ore": { category: "quartz", minTier: 1, dropItem: "minecraft:quartz" },
  "minecraft:ancient_debris": { category: "ancient_debris", minTier: 4, dropItem: "minecraft:ancient_debris" },
};

function getOreInfo(blockId) {
  if (!blockId) return null;
  return ORE_DEFINITIONS[blockId] || null;
}

const NEIGHBOR_OFFSETS_26 = (() => {
  const offsets = [];
  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
      for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz++) {
        if (dx === 0 && dy === 0 && dz === 0) continue;
        offsets.push({ dx, dy, dz });
      }
    }
  }
  return offsets;
})();

const FORTUNE_AFFECTED_ORE_CATEGORIES = new Set([
  "coal", "copper", "lapis", "nether_gold", "diamond", "emerald", "quartz",
]);

function calculateRedstoneDropCount(fortuneLevel, minBase = 4, maxBase = 5) {
  const base = Math.floor(Math.random() * (maxBase - minBase + 1)) + minBase;
  return base + (fortuneLevel > 0 ? Math.floor(Math.random() * (fortuneLevel + 1)) : 0);
}

const ORE_XP = {
  coal: [0, 2],
  lapis: [2, 5],
  redstone: [1, 5],
  diamond: [3, 7],
  emerald: [3, 7],
  quartz: [2, 5],
  nether_gold: [0, 1],
};

function rollOreExperience(category) {
  const range = ORE_XP[category];
  if (!range) return 0;
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * (range[1] - range[0] + 1)) + range[0];
}

function awardChainExperience(player, dimension, loc, total) {
  if (!loc || total <= 0) return;
  const orbs = Math.min(total, CONFIG.XP_ORB_LIMIT);
  for (let i = 0; i < orbs; i++) {
    try {
      dimension.spawnEntity("minecraft:xp_orb", { x: loc.x + 0.5, y: loc.y + 0.5, z: loc.z + 0.5 });
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  const rest = total - orbs;
  if (rest > 0) {
    try {
      player.addExperience(rest);
    } catch (e) {}
  }
}

function calculateFortuneDropCount(fortuneLevel, minBase = 1, maxBase = 1, fortuneApplies = true) {
  const baseCount = minBase === maxBase
    ? minBase
    : Math.floor(Math.random() * (maxBase - minBase + 1)) + minBase;
  if (fortuneLevel <= 0 || !fortuneApplies) return baseCount;
  const multiplier = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Math.random() * (fortuneLevel + 2)));
  return Math.min(baseCount * multiplier, 64);
}

function executeDominoOreMiner(player, dimension, startLoc, startBlockId, onComplete) {
  if (!CONFIG.DOMINO_ORE_MINER_ENABLED) {
    if (onComplete) onComplete();
    return;
  }

  const startOreInfo = getOreInfo(startBlockId);
  if (!startOreInfo) {
    if (onComplete) onComplete();
    return;
  }

  const targetCategory = startOreInfo.category;
  const maxClusterSize = targetCategory === "ancient_debris"
    ? (CONFIG.MAX_ANCIENT_DEBRIS_CLUSTER_SIZE || 4)
    : CONFIG.MAX_ORE_CLUSTER_SIZE;
  const queue = [{ x: startLoc.x, y: startLoc.y, z: startLoc.z }];
  const visited = new Set();
  visited.add(`${startLoc.x},${startLoc.y},${startLoc.z}`);

  const blocksToBreak = [];

  while (queue.length > 0 && blocksToBreak.length < maxClusterSize) {
    const current = queue.shift();

    for (const offset of NEIGHBOR_OFFSETS_26) {
      if (blocksToBreak.length >= maxClusterSize) break;

      const nx = current.x + offset.dx;
      const ny = current.y + offset.dy;
      const nz = current.z + offset.dz;
      const key = `${nx},${ny},${nz}`;

      if (visited.has(key)) continue;
      visited.add(key);

      try {
        const neighborBlock = dimension.getBlock({ x: nx, y: ny, z: nz });
        if (!neighborBlock) continue;

        const neighborInfo = getOreInfo(neighborBlock.typeId);
        if (!neighborInfo) continue;

        if (neighborInfo.category === targetCategory) {
          const loc = { x: nx, y: ny, z: nz, typeId: neighborBlock.typeId };
          blocksToBreak.push(loc);
          queue.push(loc);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  if (blocksToBreak.length === 0) {
    if (onComplete) onComplete();
    return;
  }

  const tool = getMainhandTool(player);
  const toolTypeId = tool?.typeId;
  if (!isPickaxe(toolTypeId)) {
    if (onComplete) onComplete();
    return;
  }
  const toolTier = getPickaxeTier(toolTypeId);

  let hasSilkTouch = false;
  let fortuneLevel = 0;
  const creative = isGameMode(player, "creative");
  const drops = new Map();
  let xpTotal = 0;
  let xpPos;

  try {
    const enchantable = tool?.getComponent("minecraft:enchantable") || tool?.getComponent("enchantable");
    if (enchantable) {
      for (const ench of enchantable.getEnchantments()) {
        const enchId = (ench.type?.id || ench.id || "").toLowerCase();
        if (enchId.includes("silk_touch")) hasSilkTouch = true;
        if (enchId.includes("fortune")) fortuneLevel = Math.max(fortuneLevel, ench.level);
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  for (const blockData of blocksToBreak) {
    if (!player || !player.isValid()) break;

    const safety = checkToolSafety(player);
    if (!safety.safe) {
      notifyToolProtection(player, safety.remaining);
      break;
    }

    const oreInfo = getOreInfo(blockData.typeId);
    if (!oreInfo) continue;

    if (!creative && toolTier < oreInfo.minTier) break;

    try {
      removeBlockAt(dimension, blockData);
      if (creative) continue;
      if (hasSilkTouch) {
        addGroupedDrop(drops, blockData, blockData.typeId, 1);
      } else {
        const dropId = oreInfo.dropItem || blockData.typeId;
        const count = !oreInfo.dropItem
          ? 1
          : oreInfo.category === "redstone"
            ? calculateRedstoneDropCount(fortuneLevel, oreInfo.minDrop || 4, oreInfo.maxDrop || 5)
            : calculateFortuneDropCount(
                fortuneLevel,
                oreInfo.minDrop || 1,
                oreInfo.maxDrop || 1,
                FORTUNE_AFFECTED_ORE_CATEGORIES.has(oreInfo.category)
              );
        addGroupedDrop(drops, blockData, dropId, count);
        const xp = rollOreExperience(oreInfo.category);
        if (xp > 0) {
          xpTotal += xp;
          if (!xpPos) xpPos = blockData;
        }
      }
      applyToolDurabilityDamage(player);
    } catch (err) {}
  }

  spawnGroupedDrops(dimension, drops);
  awardChainExperience(player, dimension, xpPos, xpTotal);

  if (onComplete) onComplete();
}

const activeMiningOperations = new Set();
const chainPauseUntil = new Map();
const lastSwap = new Map();
const swapBack = new Map();

world.beforeEvents.itemUse.subscribe((event) => {
  const player = event.source;
  const itemStack = event.itemStack;

  if (!player || !player.isSneaking) return;
  if (!itemStack || !SUPPORTED_OFFHAND_ITEMS.has(itemStack.typeId)) return;

  event.cancel = true;
  system.run(() => {
    swapHands(player);
  });
});

world.afterEvents.entityHitBlock.subscribe((event) => {
  try {
    const player = event.damagingEntity;
    if (!player || player.typeId !== "minecraft:player") return;
    if (player.selectedSlotIndex !== CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT) return;

    const block = event.hitBlock;
    if (!block) return;

    const category = getRequiredToolCategory(block.typeId);
    if (!category) return;

    const now = system.currentTick;
    const lastCombat = recentCombat.get(player.id) ?? -Infinity;
    if (now - lastCombat < CONFIG.COMBAT_COOLDOWN_TICKS) return;

    webInteraction.set(player.id, {
      key: blockKey(block),
      lastInteractionTick: now,
    });

    if (!switchPlayerSlot1Tool(player, category, block.typeId)) {
      scheduleSwapRetry(player, category, block.typeId);
    }
  } catch (e) {}
});

world.afterEvents.entityHitEntity.subscribe((event) => {
  try {
    const player = event.damagingEntity;
    if (!player || player.typeId !== "minecraft:player") return;
    if (player.selectedSlotIndex !== CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT) return;
    if (!isCombatTarget(event.hitEntity)) return;

    recentCombat.set(player.id, system.currentTick);
    clearPendingSwap(player.id);
    webInteraction.delete(player.id);

    switchPlayerSlot1Tool(player, ToolCategory.WEAPON);
  } catch (e) {}
});

function finishChain(player) {
  activeMiningOperations.delete(player.id);
  flushToolDamage(player);
  miningActivity.delete(player.id);
  lastAutoSwitchKey.delete(player.id);
}

world.afterEvents.playerBreakBlock.subscribe((event) => {
  const { block, brokenBlockPermutation, player, dimension, itemStackBeforeBreak } = event;

  if (!player || !player.isValid()) return;
  if (MINING_OPTIONS.REQUIRE_SNEAK_FOR_CHAIN_MINING) {
    if (!player.isSneaking) return;
  } else if (player.selectedSlotIndex !== CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT) {
    return;
  }
  if (activeMiningOperations.has(player.id)) return;

  const startLoc = {
    x: Math.floor(block.location.x),
    y: Math.floor(block.location.y),
    z: Math.floor(block.location.z),
  };
  const brokenTypeId = brokenBlockPermutation?.type?.id;
  if (!brokenTypeId) return;

  const tool = itemStackBeforeBreak || getMainhandTool(player);
  if (!tool) return;

  const heldNow = getMainhandTool(player);
  if (!heldNow || heldNow.typeId !== tool.typeId) {
    const swap = lastSwap.get(player.id);
    const swapContainer = getContainer(player);
    if (swap && swapContainer && system.currentTick - swap.tick <= CONFIG.SWAP_RESTORE_TICKS) {
      try {
        const moved = swapContainer.getItem(swap.slot);
        if (moved && moved.typeId === tool.typeId) {
          swapContainer.swapItems(swap.slot, CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT, swapContainer);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    const restored = getMainhandTool(player);
    if (!restored || restored.typeId !== tool.typeId) return;
  }

  const toolTypeId = tool.typeId;

  if (isAxe(toolTypeId) && isEligibleLog(brokenTypeId)) {
    const treeSafety = checkToolSafety(player);
    if (!treeSafety.safe) {
      notifyToolProtection(player, Math.max(0, treeSafety.remaining));
      return;
    }
    activeMiningOperations.add(player.id);
    chainPauseUntil.set(player.id, system.currentTick + CONFIG.CHAIN_PAUSE_TICKS);
    try {
      executeTreeCapitator(player, dimension, startLoc, brokenTypeId, () => {
        finishChain(player);
      });
    } catch (err) {
      finishChain(player);
    }
    return;
  }

  if (isPickaxe(toolTypeId) && getOreInfo(brokenTypeId)) {
    const oreSafety = checkToolSafety(player);
    if (!oreSafety.safe) {
      notifyToolProtection(player, Math.max(0, oreSafety.remaining));
      return;
    }
    activeMiningOperations.add(player.id);
    chainPauseUntil.set(player.id, system.currentTick + CONFIG.CHAIN_PAUSE_TICKS);
    try {
      executeDominoOreMiner(player, dimension, startLoc, brokenTypeId, () => {
        finishChain(player);
      });
    } catch (err) {
      finishChain(player);
    }
    return;
  }
});

system.runInterval(() => {
  let players;
  try {
    players = world.getAllPlayers();
  } catch (e) {
    return;
  }

  const tick = system.currentTick;
  const doLight = tick % CONFIG.LIGHT_UPDATE_TICKS === 0;

  for (const player of players) {
    try {
      const state = getQolState(player.id);
      const sneaking = !!player.isSneaking;

      if (sneaking && !state.sneakHeld) {
        let still = true;
        try {
          const v = player.getVelocity();
          still = Math.hypot(v.x, v.z) < CONFIG.STILL_SPEED_LIMIT && player.isOnGround !== false;
        } catch (e) {}
        if (still) {
          state.sneakCount += 1;
          state.sneakTimer = 0;
        } else {
          state.sneakCount = 0;
          state.sneakTimer = 0;
        }
      }
      state.sneakHeld = sneaking;

      if (state.sneakCount > 0) {
        state.sneakTimer += 1;
        if (state.sneakTimer > CONFIG.SWAP_WINDOW_TICKS) {
          state.sneakCount = 0;
          state.sneakTimer = 0;
        }
      }

      if (state.sneakCount >= 2) {
        state.sneakCount = 0;
        state.sneakTimer = 0;
        swapHands(player);
      }

      if (doLight && (state.lightLevel > 0 || tick % CONFIG.IDLE_LIGHT_CHECK_TICKS === 0)) {
        updatePlayerLight(player, state);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
}, 1);

system.runInterval(() => {
  const now = system.currentTick;

  for (const player of world.getAllPlayers()) {
    try {
      if (player.selectedSlotIndex !== CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT) {
        webInteraction.delete(player.id);
        continue;
      }

      const lastCombat = recentCombat.get(player.id) ?? -Infinity;
      if (now - lastCombat < CONFIG.WEB_COMBAT_COOLDOWN) continue;

      const block = getTargetBlock(player);
      if (!isWeb(block)) {
        webInteraction.delete(player.id);
        continue;
      }

      const key = blockKey(block);
      const state = webInteraction.get(player.id);

      if (!state || state.key !== key) {
        webInteraction.set(player.id, {
          key,
          lastInteractionTick: -Infinity,
          initialTick: now,
        });
        continue;
      }

      const elapsed = now - state.initialTick;
      if (elapsed < CONFIG.WEB_INTERACTION_WINDOW) continue;

      if (now - state.lastInteractionTick > CONFIG.WEB_INTERACTION_WINDOW) {
        webInteraction.delete(player.id);
        continue;
      }

      const inventory = getContainer(player);
      const held = inventory?.getItem(CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT);
      if (held && normalizeId(held.typeId).includes("shears")) continue;

      switchPlayerSlot1Tool(player, ToolCategory.WEB, block.typeId);
      webInteraction.set(player.id, {
        key,
        initialTick: now,
        lastInteractionTick: now,
      });
    } catch (e) {}
  }
}, CONFIG.WEB_CHECK_INTERVAL);

const MINING_ACTIVE_TICKS = 10;
const miningActivity = new Map();
const lastAutoSwitchKey = new Map();
const lastBreakTick = new Map();

function markMining(player) {
  if (!player || player.typeId !== "minecraft:player") return;
  if (system.currentTick < (chainPauseUntil.get(player.id) ?? 0)) return;
  miningActivity.set(player.id, system.currentTick);
}

world.afterEvents.entityHitBlock.subscribe((event) => {
  try {
    markMining(event.damagingEntity);
  } catch (e) {}
});

world.afterEvents.playerBreakBlock.subscribe((event) => {
  try {
    lastBreakTick.set(event.player.id, system.currentTick);
  } catch (e) {}
});

system.runInterval(() => {
  const now = system.currentTick;
  for (const player of world.getAllPlayers()) {
    try {
      const last = miningActivity.get(player.id);
      if (last === undefined || now - last > CONFIG.MINING_ACTIVE_TICKS) {
        lastAutoSwitchKey.delete(player.id);
        if (swapBack.has(player.id)) {
          const idleSince = Math.max(
            last ?? -Infinity,
            lastBreakTick.get(player.id) ?? -Infinity,
            recentCombat.get(player.id) ?? -Infinity,
            lastSwap.get(player.id)?.tick ?? -Infinity
          );
          if (now - idleSince > CONFIG.SWAP_BACK_TICKS && now >= (chainPauseUntil.get(player.id) ?? 0)) {
            restoreSwappedItem(player);
          }
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (player.selectedSlotIndex !== CONFIG.AUTO_SWITCH_SLOT) continue;

      const lastCombat = recentCombat.get(player.id) ?? -Infinity;
      if (now - lastCombat < CONFIG.COMBAT_COOLDOWN_TICKS) continue;

      if (now - (lastBreakTick.get(player.id) ?? -Infinity) < CONFIG.BREAK_SWITCH_DELAY_TICKS) continue;

      const target = getTargetBlock(player);
      if (!target) continue;

      const key = blockKey(target);
      if (lastAutoSwitchKey.get(player.id) === key) continue;

      const category = getRequiredToolCategory(target.typeId);
      if (!category) continue;

      lastAutoSwitchKey.set(player.id, key);
      switchPlayerSlot1Tool(player, category, target.typeId);
    } catch (e) {}
  }
}, 1);

world.afterEvents.playerLeave.subscribe((event) => {
  miningActivity.delete(event.playerId);
  lastAutoSwitchKey.delete(event.playerId);
});

world.afterEvents.playerPlaceBlock.subscribe((event) => {
  try {
    const player = event.player;
    const state = qolPlayerState.get(player.id);
    if (!state || state.lightX === undefined) return;
    const placed = event.block;
    if (placed.x !== state.lightX || placed.y !== state.lightY || placed.z !== state.lightZ) return;
    state.lightX = undefined;
    state.lightY = undefined;
    state.lightZ = undefined;
    state.lightLevel = 0;
    updatePlayerLight(player, state);
  } catch (e) {}
});

world.afterEvents.playerLeave.subscribe((event) => {
  const id = event.playerId;
  if (!id) return;
  const state = qolPlayerState.get(id);
  if (state) clearPlacedLight(state);
  qolPlayerState.delete(id);
  recentCombat.delete(id);
  webInteraction.delete(id);
  clearPendingSwap(id);
  activeMiningOperations.delete(id);
  lastSwap.delete(id);
  swapBack.delete(id);
  lastBreakTick.delete(id);
});

if (world.afterEvents.playerDimensionChange) {
  world.afterEvents.playerDimensionChange.subscribe((event) => {
    try {
      const state = getQolState(event.player.id);
      clearPlacedLight(state);
    } catch (e) {}
  });
}

system.runTimeout(() => {
  try {
    const raw = world.getDynamicProperty("qol:lights");
    if (typeof raw === "string") {
      const active = new Set();
      for (const st of qolPlayerState.values()) {
        if (st.lightDim !== undefined && st.lightX !== undefined) {
          active.add(`${st.lightDim.id},${st.lightX},${st.lightY},${st.lightZ}`);
        }
      }
      for (const [dimId, x, y, z] of JSON.parse(raw)) {
        if (active.has(`${dimId},${x},${y},${z}`)) continue;
        try {
          const b = world.getDimension(dimId).getBlock({ x, y, z });
          if (b && isLightBlock(b.typeId)) b.setPermutation(BlockPermutation.resolve("minecraft:air"));
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  lightsCleaned = true;
  persistLights();

  try {
    if (!world.getDynamicProperty("qol:gamerules_set")) {
      const dim = world.getDimension("overworld");
      dim.runCommand(`gamerule playersSleepingPercentage ${CONFIG.SLEEP_PERCENTAGE}`);
      dim.runCommand(`gamerule randomTickSpeed ${CONFIG.RANDOM_TICK_SPEED}`);
      world.setDynamicProperty("qol:gamerules_set", true);
    }
  } catch (e) {}
}, CONFIG.STARTUP_DELAY_TICKS);

console.warn(`${LOG_PREFIX} Initialized. Tree Capitator: ${CONFIG.TREE_CAPITATOR_ENABLED ? "ON" : "OFF"}; Vein Miner: ${CONFIG.DOMINO_ORE_MINER_ENABLED ? "ON" : "OFF"}.`);
```
