## FILE: MCPEDL/Addons/Vanilla-Quality-of-Life/CHANGELOG.md (357 lines, 15767 bytes)

```
# Changelog — Vanilla Quality of Life

---

## [v3] - 2026-11-14

**What's new in v2.1.2:** Packed with the v2.1.2 update. Includes: Description Rewrite.

### Improved & Balanced

- **Clearer Description**: The listing now follows the new layout with an overview, feature cards, step-by-step instructions, common questions, and a compatibility summary.

### Fixed

- **Leash Details**: The description no longer says the Warden and Wither can be leashed, and no longer claims a fixed number of leashable mobs.
- **Creator Links**: The MCPEDL profile link and its image now appear once and point to the correct page.

## [2.1.1] - 2026-11-14

**What's new in v2.1.1:** Packed with the v2.1.1 update. Includes: Swap-Back and Chain Mining Polish.

### Added

- **Swap-Back After Mining**: A moment after you stop mining or fighting, the item that was in Slot 1 returns to its original slot instead of staying swapped.
- **Tree Size Message**: An action-bar message now tells you when a tree was too large to fell completely.

### Improved & Balanced

- **Faster Auto-Switch**: Auto-switch now waits only about a tenth of a second after a block breaks, so it keeps up with instant-break blocks.
- **Hotbar-Only Tool Search**: Auto-switch now only uses tools from your hotbar, so items in your backpack are never moved.
- **Chain Mining Experience**: Chain mining now spawns at most 10 experience orbs per chain and gives any extra experience straight to you, so far fewer orbs appear.
- **Lighter Held Light Checks**: The held-light update does less work while you carry no light item.



## [2.1.0] - 2026-11-07

**What's new in v2.0.1.0:** Packed with the v2.0.0.1 update.

### Added

- **More Held Lights**: Glowstone, Sea Lanterns, Shroomlights, and Jack o'Lanterns now light up your surroundings at Light Level 15 while you hold them.
- **Silk Touch Auto-Switch**: Hitting glass or ice now switches to a Silk Touch tool if you carry one, and bookshelves prefer a Silk Touch Axe.

### Improved & Balanced

- **Mending Preference**: When two tools are equally good for a job, auto-switch now uses the Mending tool that needs repair first.
- **Grouped Chain Drops**: Tree Capitator and Domino Ore Miner now merge their drops into full stacks within 5-block areas, so far fewer item entities appear.
- **Direct Block Breaking**: Tree Capitator and Domino Ore Miner now break blocks and place their drops directly instead of running game commands.





## [2.0.0] - 2026-11-06

**What's new in v2.0.0.0:** Packed with 2 updates, from v1.4.1 through v1.4.2.

### Removed

- **Offhand Swap Command**: The command that swapped your offhand item is removed. Use double-sneak or Sneak + Use in the air instead.
- **Personal Toggles**: The per-player toggles added in the previous update are removed. Choose how Tree Capitator and Domino Ore Miner behave for your world with the Behavior Pack's subpack settings.

### Added

- **Personal Toggles**: Each player can turn Auto-Switch, Tree Capitator, Domino Ore Miner, and Offhand Quick-Swap on or off for themselves with /scriptevent qol:toggle. Use status to see your settings and reset to turn everything back on.

### Improved & Balanced

- **Zero Durability Tools**: A tool at 0 durability now breaks only the single block you hit and no longer starts Tree Capitator or Domino Ore Miner.
- **Durability Floor**: Tree Capitator and Domino Ore Miner now use your tool down to 0 durability without breaking it, and the next use of that tool breaks it.





## [1.0.0] - 2026-11-02

**What's new in v1.4.0:** Packed with the v1.3.30 update.

### v1.3.x (v1.3.30)

#### Improved & Balanced
- **Smoother Held Light**: The light from torches and lanterns in your hands now updates every tick, so it keeps up with you while moving and jumping.
- **Auto-Switch Only While Mining**: Auto-switch now acts only while you are hitting blocks and no longer changes your tool just because you are looking at something.

#### Fixed
- **Light Flicker While Pillar Jumping**: Placing a block where your held light was no longer leaves you in the dark; the light moves back to you immediately.
- **Durability After Auto-Switch**: If auto-switch changes your tool at the same moment a tree or ore vein is chain mined, the tool you actually mined with is put back in your hand and takes the durability loss instead of the new tool.
- **Switch Delay After Breaking**: Auto-switch now waits a few ticks after any block breaks before changing your tool, so the tool you broke the block with keeps its durability loss.





## [1.29.0] - 2026-11-02

### Fixed
- **Tool Durability**: Tree Capitator and Domino Ore Miner now reliably wear down the tool you used, even if auto-switch changes your held item right afterward.
- **Mangrove Trees**: Mangrove trees with moss carpet around their roots are now felled, and breaking Muddy Mangrove Roots no longer switches you to a shovel.
- **Auto-Switch After Chain Mining**: Auto-switch now waits about two seconds after a tree or ore vein is chain mined before it can change your tool.





## [1.28.0] - 2026-11-01

### Improved & Balanced
- **Clearer Mining Presets**: The three mining presets in the pack settings now describe what they do: Sneak to Chain Mine (Default), Auto Chain Mine: Tool in Slot 1, and Chain Mining Off (Other Features On).

- **Resource Pack Included**: The Behavior Pack now requires its Resource Pack, so both are enabled together when you activate it.





## [1.27.0] - 2026-11-01

### Fixed

- **Enchanted Tool Offhand Swap**: Swapping an enchanted or damaged tool into your offhand with a torch no longer resets it, so enchantments and remaining durability are kept.

## [1.3.24] — 2026-10-29

- **Durability Guard**: Chain mining now stops only when the tool has 0 durability left, instead of at 1.
- **Offhand Torch Placement Removed**: Torches in the offhand can no longer be placed with Sneak + Click. Offhand quick-swap and held-item light still work.

### Fixed
- **Auto-Switch With Chain Mining**: Auto-switch now pauses briefly while a tree or ore vein is being mined so the tool in hand cannot change during it.
- **Broken Tool Chain Mining**: Tree Capitator and Domino Ore Miner no longer keep breaking blocks after the tool has broken or has no durability left.





## [1.3.22] — 2026-10-28

### Improved & Balanced
- **Continuous Auto-Switch**: While you keep mining, aiming at a different kind of block, such as moving from stone to dirt, now switches to the best tool without stopping.





## [1.3.21] — 2026-10-28

### Improved & Balanced
- **Redstone Fortune**: Chain-mined Redstone Ore with Fortune now drops extra dust the way the single-block version does, instead of multiplying the whole stack.
- **Ore Experience**: Chain-mined ores now drop their normal experience as orbs when mined without Silk Touch.
- **Tree Capitator Limits**: Logs more than 8 blocks away from the broken log are ignored, so neighboring trees are far less likely to be felled together.
- **Player Build Protection**: Trees touching planks, doors, fences, glass, bricks, or storage blocks are left standing.
- **Game Rules**: Sleep skipping and the faster random tick speed are now set once when the world first loads, so you can change them afterward.

### Fixed
- **Cobweb Shears Switch**: Looking at a cobweb no longer swaps shears into your hand; the swap now happens only when you hit the cobweb.
- **Creative Mode**: Chain mining and tree felling no longer wear down tools or drop items in Creative.
- **Melon and Pumpkin Stems**: Breaking a stem with an axe no longer fells nearby trees.
- **Accidental Hand Swap**: Quickly tapping sneak while moving or in the air, such as while bridging, no longer swaps your hands.
- **Leftover Light Blocks**: Moving light blocks left behind after a crash or reload are now removed the next time the world loads.

## [1.3.0] — 2026-10-15

This major milestone integrates **Passive Auto-Switch Tools**, **Smart Tree Capitator**, and **Domino Ore Miner** directly into the core Vanilla Quality of Life suite, creating the ultimate all-in-one survival add-on for Minecraft Bedrock.

  — Automatic tool selection whenever the player attacks or mines blocks while holding **Slot 1** (first hotbar slot).
  — Automatically equips Pickaxe (stone, ores, obsidian, terracotta), Axe (logs, wood, planks), Shovel (dirt, sand, gravel, clay), Shears (cobwebs, leaves), and Hoe.
  — Automatically equips the best melee weapon (Sword, Axe, or Mace) when attacking hostile or passive mobs.
  — Durability health scoring: Intelligently avoids selecting nearly-broken tools to preserve gear.
  — Automated cobweb shear interaction loop.

  — Sneak while chopping any tree log to fell the entire trunk and connected branches up to **128 logs** immediately.
  — **Tree Species Matching**: Ensures Oak only fells Oak and Birch only fells Birch, preventing collateral damage in dense tree farms or forests.
  — Preserves natural leaf canopies for authentic vanilla leaf decay drops (saplings, sticks, apples).

  — Sneak while mining any mineral ore to harvest the entire contiguous vein across **all 26 spatial neighbors** (faces, edges, corners) up to **64 blocks**.
  — **Mineral Category Normalization**: Groups regular and deepslate ore variants so veins crossing stone layers mine seamlessly together.
  — Full Fortune and Silk Touch support: Correctly honors Silk Touch block drops and vanilla Fortune item multipliers.

  — When holding a Torch, Soul Torch, or Redstone Torch in your offhand, simply **Sneak and Click** on any block to place it directly from your offhand onto the floor or wall.
  — Decrements offhand stack in Survival/Adventure mode (unlimited in Creative).
  — Cave-mining quality of life: keep your Pickaxe in your mainhand while placing torches without swapping items.

  — Automatically halts chain breaks when tool durability drops to **1 point remaining**.
  — Flashes an on-screen action bar warning and plays an alert sound to protect valuable enchanted tools.

```
# Vanilla Quality of Life — Survival convenience features for Minecraft Bedrock

**By ALNStudios**

[![Minecraft Bedrock](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft%20Bedrock-Stable%20Release-brightgreen?style=flat-square&logo=minecraft)](https://github.com/AllensCreations/MCPE-Curseforges)
[![Format](https://img.shields.io/badge/Format-.MCPACK%20%7C%20.MCADDON%20%7C%20.MCWORLD-blue?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/AllensCreations/MCPE-Curseforges)

**Auto-switching tools, 128-log tree felling, and 64-ore vein mining with Tree Capitator and Domino Ore Miner for Minecraft Bedrock.**

> Adds automatic tool and weapon switching, Tree Capitator, Domino Ore Miner, offhand quick-swap with moving held light, extra leashable mobs, new recipes, and Wandering Trader collector trades.

## Overview

Hit a block and the best tool from your hotbar swaps into Slot 1, then returns a moment after you stop. Sneak while chopping a log or mining an ore to fell the whole tree or take the connected vein.

## Key Features

### Tool and Weapon Auto-Switch
- **What Happens**: With Slot 1 selected, hitting a block or mob swaps the best tool from your hotbar into Slot 1, and the item that was there returns a moment after you stop.
- **Good To Know**: Tools close to breaking are avoided, and a Mending tool that needs repair wins when two tools are equally good.

### Tree Capitator
- **What Happens**: Sneak while chopping a log with an Axe to fell the whole tree, up to 128 logs, with the drops merged into full stacks within 5-block areas.
- **Good To Know**: Trees touching player-built blocks such as planks, doors, fences, glass, bricks, or storage are left standing, and logs more than 8 blocks sideways from the broken log are ignored.

### Domino Ore Miner
- **What Happens**: Sneak while mining an ore with a Pickaxe to harvest the connected vein, up to 64 ore blocks, or 4 for Ancient Debris.
- **Good To Know**: Ores give their normal experience without Silk Touch, as up to 10 orbs per chain with any extra going straight to you.

### Mining Presets
- **What Happens**: Three presets in the Behavior Pack's subpack settings choose how chain mining starts: Sneak to Chain Mine (Default), Auto Chain Mine: Tool in Slot 1, and Chain Mining Off (Other Features On).
- **Good To Know**: Changing the preset may need the pack reactivated or the world reloaded.

### Tool Durability Guard
- **What Happens**: Chain mining stops when your tool has 0 durability left, with a warning sound and an action-bar alert.
- **Good To Know**: A tool at 0 durability breaks only the single block you hit and does not start Tree Capitator or Domino Ore Miner.

### Offhand Quick-Swap and Held Light
- **What Happens**: Double-sneak while standing still, or sneak and use in the air, to move your held item into your offhand.

### Universal Leads
- **What Happens**: Leads work on Villagers, Iron Golems, Creepers, Endermen, Ghasts, and most other mobs, while the Warden, Wither, and Ender Dragon cannot be leashed.

### Pet and Mount Protection
- **What Happens**: Tamed Wolves, Cats, Parrots, Horses, Donkeys, Mules, and Llamas take no damage from player melee attacks, sweeping strikes, and arrows.
- **Good To Know**: Tamed animals are also immune to Creeper and TNT explosion damage.

## How to Use

1. Import the complete add-on and enable both included packs in your world settings.
2. Choose a mining preset in the Behavior Pack's subpack settings: Sneak to Chain Mine (Default), Auto Chain Mine: Tool in Slot 1, or Chain Mining Off (Other Features On).
3. Put your tools in the hotbar, select Slot 1, and hit blocks or mobs to see the best tool swap in.
4. Sneak while breaking a log with an Axe or an ore with a Pickaxe to fell the tree or mine the vein.

## Common Questions

- **Why did a tree stay standing?**: Trees touching player-built blocks such as planks, doors, or fences are skipped, and a very large tree is cut off at 128 logs.
- **Why did auto-switch ignore a tool in my backpack?**: Auto-switch only uses tools in your hotbar.
- **What happens when a tool reaches 0 durability?**: Chain mining stops, and the next use of that tool breaks it.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft Bedrock Edition: 1.26.50 or newer.
- Experimental features: Not verified.
- Achievements: Likely achievement-friendly.
- Verification: Source created, not tested in game.

## Creator and Permissions

- Profiles: [CurseForge Profile](https://www.curseforge.com/members/allenscreations/projects) · [MCPEDL Profile](https://mcpedl.com/user/alnstudios/)

<p>Hit a block and the best tool from your hotbar swaps into Slot 1, then returns a moment after you stop. Sneak while chopping a log or mining an ore to fell the whole tree or take the connected vein.</p>
<h2 style="font-size:17px;text-align:left"><span style="background-color:#15803d;color:#ffffff;border-radius:20px">&nbsp;&nbsp;What You Get&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></h2>
<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px"><div style="flex:1;min-width:200px;border:1px solid #8a94a3;border-radius:16px"><div style="background-color:#15803d;color:#ffffff;border-radius:16px;font-size:16px;line-height:2.2"><strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;Tool and Weapon Auto-Switch</strong></div><div style="margin-left:12px;margin-right:12px"><p><span>With Slot 1 selected, hitting a block or mob swaps the best tool from your hotbar into Slot 1, and the item that was there returns a moment after you stop.</span><br><span style="font-size:13px;color:#8a94a3"><strong>Good To Know:</strong> Tools close to breaking are avoided, and a Mending tool that needs repair wins when two tools are equally good.</span></p></div></div><div style="flex:1;min-width:200px;border:1px solid #8a94a3;border-radius:16px"><div style="background-color:#15803d;color:#ffffff;border-radius:16px;font-size:16px;line-height:2.2"><strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;Tree Capitator</strong></div><div style="margin-left:12px;margin-right:12px"><p><span>Sneak while chopping a log with an Axe to fell the whole tree, up to 128 logs, with the drops merged into full stacks within 5-block areas.</span><br><span style="font-size:13px;color:#8a94a3"><strong>Good To Know:</strong> Trees touching player-built blocks such as planks, doors, fences, glass, bricks, or storage are left standing, and logs more than 8 blocks sideways from the broken log are ignored.</span></p></div></div><div style="flex:1;min-width:200px;border:1px solid #8a94a3;border-radius:16px"><div style="background-color:#15803d;color:#ffffff;border-radius:16px;font-size:16px;line-height:2.2"><strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;Domino Ore Miner</strong></div><div style="margin-left:12px;margin-right:12px"><p><span>Sneak while mining an ore with a Pickaxe to harvest the connected vein, up to 64 ore blocks, or 4 for Ancient Debris.</span><br><span style="font-size:13px;color:#8a94a3"><strong>Good To Know:</strong> Ores give their normal experience without Silk Touch, as up to 10 orbs per chain with any extra going straight to you.</span></p></div></div><div style="flex:1;min-width:200px;border:1px solid #8a94a3;border-radius:16px"><div style="background-color:#15803d;color:#ffffff;border-radius:16px;font-size:16px;line-height:2.2"><strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;Mining Presets</strong></div><div style="margin-left:12px;margin-right:12px"><p><span>Three presets in the Behavior Pack's subpack settings choose how chain mining starts: Sneak to Chain Mine (Default), Auto Chain Mine: Tool in Slot 1, and Chain Mining Off (Other Features On).</span><br><span style="font-size:13px;color:#8a94a3"><strong>Good To Know:</strong> Changing the preset may need the pack reactivated or the world reloaded.</span></p></div></div><div style="flex:1;min-width:200px;border:1px solid #8a94a3;border-radius:16px"><div style="background-color:#15803d;color:#ffffff;border-radius:16px;font-size:16px;line-height:2.2"><strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;Tool Durability Guard</strong></div><div style="margin-left:12px;margin-right:12px"><p><span>Chain mining stops when your tool has 0 durability left, with a warning sound and an action-bar alert.</span><br><span style="font-size:13px;color:#8a94a3"><strong>Good To Know:</strong> A tool at 0 durability breaks only the single block you hit and does not start Tree Capitator or Domino Ore Miner.</span></p></div></div><div style="flex:1;min-width:200px;border:1px solid #8a94a3;border-radius:16px"><div style="background-color:#15803d;color:#ffffff;border-radius:16px;font-size:16px;line-height:2.2"><strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;Offhand Quick-Swap and Held Light</strong></div><div style="margin-left:12px;margin-right:12px"><p><span>Double-sneak while standing still, or sneak and use in the air, to move your held item into your offhand.</span></p></div></div><div style="flex:1;min-width:200px;border:1px solid #8a94a3;border-radius:16px"><div style="background-color:#15803d;color:#ffffff;border-radius:16px;font-size:16px;line-height:2.2"><strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;Universal Leads</strong></div><div style="margin-left:12px;margin-right:12px"><p><span>Leads work on Villagers, Iron Golems, Creepers, Endermen, Ghasts, and most other mobs, while the Warden, Wither, and Ender Dragon cannot be leashed.</span></p></div></div><div style="flex:1;min-width:200px;border:1px solid #8a94a3;border-radius:16px"><div style="background-color:#15803d;color:#ffffff;border-radius:16px;font-size:16px;line-height:2.2"><strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;Pet and Mount Protection</strong></div><div style="margin-left:12px;margin-right:12px"><p><span>Tamed Wolves, Cats, Parrots, Horses, Donkeys, Mules, and Llamas take no damage from player melee attacks, sweeping strikes, and arrows.</span><br><span style="font-size:13px;color:#8a94a3"><strong>Good To Know:</strong> Tamed animals are also immune to Creeper and TNT explosion damage.</span></p></div></div></div>

<div class="spoiler" title="Why did a tree stay standing?" data-title="Why did a tree stay standing?"><p><strong>Why did a tree stay standing?</strong><br>Trees touching player-built blocks such as planks, doors, or fences are skipped, and a very large tree is cut off at 128 logs.</p></div><div class="spoiler" title="Why did auto-switch ignore a tool in my backpack?" data-title="Why did auto-switch ignore a tool in my backpack?"><p><strong>Why did auto-switch ignore a tool in my backpack?</strong><br>Auto-switch only uses tools in your hotbar.</p></div><div class="spoiler" title="What happens when a tool reaches 0 durability?" data-title="What happens when a tool reaches 0 durability?"><p><strong>What happens when a tool reaches 0 durability?</strong><br>Chain mining stops, and the next use of that tool breaks it.</p></div>
